html:
A Roman princess, daughter of Theodosius I, whose life ran through the fall of the western empire. She was in Rome when the Visigoths sacked it in 410, and they carried her off as a captive.

  • In 414 she married the Gothic king Athaulf; their baby son died, and Athaulf was murdered in 415.
  • The Goths handed her back to Rome in 416 in exchange for grain. She was made to marry the general Constantius, who briefly became emperor in 421.
  • After a quarrel with her brother, the emperor Honorius, she fled to Constantinople.
  • In 425 an eastern army put her young son Valentinian III on the western throne, and she ruled for him from Ravenna for about twelve years.

As regent she struggled with the generals, and lost power to Aetius. She built churches in Ravenna. The small chapel known as the Mausoleum of Galla Placidia bears her name, but she died in Rome in 450 and was most likely buried there.
